New OTT Releases This Week Feature 'Mirzapur The Movie', 'Baththa', 'Akka'

Several new movies and shows are set to be released on Over-The-Top (OTT) platforms this week, spanning October 26 to October 30. Titles include 'Mirzapur The Movie', 'Obsession', 'Akka', 'Baththa', and 'Meethe Mein Kya Hai'. These releases will be available on platforms such as Netflix, Prime Video, and JioHotstar.
